text:
Liam: Morning team! First day. Quick org map Q: who owns secrets for Private deployments (KMS/HSM keys, vault paths)? Also who triages incoming 'access exception' requests?

Nina: hey @Liam welcome :tada: Security owns key management but eng-infra handles the cloud-side setup. For vault paths, security-eng maintains the namespace /secret/private/.

Marco: to add, eng-infra runs the provisioning playbooks. If you need a key created for a workspace, file an infra ticket and tag security-eng.

Liam: cool — who should I ping for a quick walkthrough on the private deploy checklist?

Leah: People Ops pairs new hires with a buddy for 2 weeks. I'll assign you a buddy from eng-platform unless you prefer eng-runtime. Buddy will do the walkthrough.

Liam: prefer eng-platform if possible.

Leah: noted. Assigning now.

sre-bot: PagerPolicy: private-deploy-alert -> #eng-oncall (2m). If unacked -> #eng-sre-secondary (10m) -> #eng-infra-escalation (20m).

Marco: Access exceptions: process is 1) create ticket in infra-triage, 2) tag security-eng + your manager, 3) include justification and duration. Example ticket body: ```reason: integration test with vendorX duration: 72h level: write``` 

Nina: Ownership quick list (DM me if you want edits):
- KMS/HSM provisioning: security-eng
- Vault path creation & ACLs: security-eng + eng-infra for cloud ops
- Private deploy CI pipelines: eng-runtime
- Rollouts and canary config: eng-platform
- Emergency oncall: eng-sre
- Access exceptions & legal review: security + legal

Liam: great. And escalation if the private deploy pipeline flaps during business hours and the oncall doesn't pick up? Any auto-fallback?

Marco: we have a fallback: pipeline auto-retry x3 then gate to a stable model (older image). If oncall unacked after 15m, escalation matches the pager policy above and ops-manager is paged at 40m. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/private-deploys

Leah: also, your buddy will get you the short cheat sheet: dev -> local -> staging -> private flow. If something blocks you DM your buddy and put "onboard:block" in the ticket title.

Liam: awesome, thanks all. One tiny nit: is there a canonical matrix for "who to ask" per surface (IAM, infra, runtime, security)? Could help for new folks.

Nina: good call. We have a living doc but it's scattered. I'll start a repo page and ping this thread when I add it.

Marco: added a quick starter snippet you can paste in tickets: ```component: infra area: vault owner: security-eng contact: @security-eng triage: infra-triage```

Liam: saved. Thanks team! :pray:
